description: Biz, Türkiye'deki ODTÜ Kalkınma Vakfı Okullarından meraklı ve yaratıcı ortaokul öğrencilerinden oluşan Tekno Çekirgeler'iz. Astronomi, bilim ve uzay teknolojisine tutkuyla bağlıyız; NASA'nın açık verilerini keşfetmeyi ve gerçek dünya zorluklarına yenilikçi çözümler geliştirmeyi hedefliyoruz. Takım çalışmasına, yaratıcılığa ve problem çözmeye değer veriyoruz. Kodlama, mühendislik, araştırma ve dijital tasarımla ilgilenen üyeleri memnuniyetle karşılıyoruz. Birlikte keşfeder, keşfeder ve yenilik yaparız!
summary: We all know that there are several risks for astronauts at space. For us, radiation and micro gravity is the most important ones. To solve the problem of the weakness of astronauts' bones caused by gravity, we created a system which the user can follow his/her development or decline of bone health and mineral needs. The user can use AI to create an eating plan or a checklist to follow and become healthier. And to protect astronauts from radiation we created a water shield that can be adjusted automaticly to control the radiation amount and help it stay under the limit.
details: First we did all the reasearch needed. Then we optimized the data and created anlysis. Then we created the formules needed and with all the structural items we discussed we gave these info to ai studio google to create an app. Then we discussed all the advancements that we needed to make and completed our project. The creative part of the project is that we found all the solutions and formules by our own.
